<hr>


Terraform module to create and manage Azure Relay on Azure. It creates a Relay namespace, hybrid connections (with client authorization required by default), namespace- and entity-level shared access policies, Entra ID role assignments scoped to the namespace or a single hybrid connection, an optional private endpoint, and optional diagnostic settings.

## Known limitations & operational notes

- **SKU**: Azure Relay only offers the `Standard` SKU.
- **Network access**: the `azurerm` provider does not expose public network access, IP rules or local (SAS) auth settings for Relay namespaces. Use the private endpoint to keep traffic on your network, and prefer `role_assignments` (Entra ID) over shared access keys.
- **Root key**: Azure creates `RootManageSharedAccessKey` on every namespace. Do not hand it to applications; create narrower `authorization_rules` instead.
- **WCF relays** are not supported by the `azurerm` provider; this module manages hybrid connections only.
- **State sensitivity**: authorization rule keys and connection strings are stored in Terraform state. Use an encrypted backend and restrict state access.

## Usage

```hcl
module "azure_relay" {
  source              = "../../"
  name                = "app"
  environment         = "dev"
  location            = "centralindia"
  resource_group_name = "rg-app-dev-inci"

  hybrid_connections = {
    reporting-db = {
      user_metadata = "On-premises reporting database listener"

      authorization_rules = {
        listener = { listen = true }
        sender   = { send = true }
      }
    }
  }

  role_assignments = {
    app-sender = {
      principal_id          = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
      role_definition_name  = "Azure Relay Sender"
      hybrid_connection_key = "reporting-db"
    }
  }

  enable_private_endpoint = true
  subnet_id               = "<subnet id>"
  private_dns_zone_ids    = "<privatelink.servicebus.windows.net zone id>"
}
```
